nodes.description: iOS app icon density variants ranging from 50x50 to 76x76 pixels (@1x, @2x, @3x). All variants display the AshaSathi app logo: teal/green background with white text reading 'ASHA SATHI'. Used for various iOS device contexts including iPhone and iPad home screen, Settings, and Spotlight.
